name: detect a cycle in a pseudorandom walk to find a collision
mechanism: iterate a pseudorandom map on residues so that two trajectories (or a slow and a fast pointer) eventually collide modulo an unknown factor; the greatest common divisor of their difference with the modulus exposes the factor (or, in a group, the collision exposes the exponent)

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Pollard's rho algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Number theoretic algorithms:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Pollard's rho algorithm for logarithms':

requires: a map that behaves randomly modulo the factor
fails_when: expected cost is the square root of the smallest factor; may fail for a given map
